hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I caught the new maid in the dim, shadowed corridor. Our new maid, timid and shy, her eyes wide with fear. The manor's corridors are cold and echo with ghostly whispers. In my drafty attic chamber, I write my private diary by the flickering tallow candlelight. In our London manor, secrets are hidden in the shadows.
caption:
Caught in the corridor, my new maid blushed with shame. Read my full diary to learn more about her in my bio link.
